cases.title: Add bookmark to a specific nested location
cases.description: Verify that a new bookmark can be successfully added into a specific nested folder within the bookmarks hierarchy.

cases.title: Add bookmark to root location
cases.description: Verify that a new bookmark can be added directly to the root location of the bookmarks hierarchy.

cases.title: Attempt to add bookmark to a non-existent location
cases.description: Verify that attempting to add a bookmark to a non-existent or invalid location ID fails gracefully or defaults safely.

cases.title: Delete single bookmark from storage and UI
cases.description: Verify that deleting a bookmark successfully removes it from the bookmarks file and ensures it is no longer displayed from any access points (Bookmarks Manager, Menu, and Toolbar).

cases.title: Verify no orphaned references after bookmark deletion
cases.description: Verify that when a bookmark is deleted, no dangling or orphaned entries or file corruption remain in the bookmarks storage file.

cases.title: Add and Delete Bookmark via Personal Toolbar
cases.description: Verify that bookmarks can be successfully added to the personal toolbar and subsequently deleted, ensuring they appear and disappear correctly from the toolbar UI.

cases.title: Negative Test for Personal Toolbar Item Addition
cases.description: Verify that dropping invalid data types or unsupported elements onto the personal toolbar is prevented and does not result in malformed toolbar entries.

cases.title: Insert new bookmark folder into hierarchy
cases.description: Verify that a new bookmark folder can be successfully inserted into a specific location within the bookmarks hierarchy.

cases.title: Insert bookmark folder with duplicate name
cases.description: Verify the system behavior when attempting to insert a new bookmark folder with a name that already exists within the same parent folder (boundary and abnormal path).

cases.title: Launch valid bookmark in browser window via double-click
cases.description: Verify that double-clicking on a bookmark with a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL causes it to be successfully launched and opened in a browser window.

cases.title: Double-clicking on a bookmark with a malformed or empty URL
cases.description: Verify the application behavior when double-clicking a bookmark with an empty URL string or a malformed URL, ensuring proper error handling or rejection without crashing the browser.

cases.title: Default packaged bookmarks link validity check
cases.description: Verify that all bookmarks within the default bookmarks file packaged with the browser contain valid, reachable URLs returning successful HTTP status codes.

cases.title: Default bookmarks broken link handling
cases.description: Verify that any broken or expired links (returning HTTP 404/500 responses) within the default bookmarks file are properly identified during validation checks.

cases.title: Save changes to bookmark item successfully
cases.description: Verify that editing a bookmark's title and URL and saving the changes updates the bookmark correctly without loss of item integrity.

cases.title: Save bookmark changes with extreme character lengths
cases.description: Verify that editing bookmark properties with maximum character limits and special characters saves successfully without data corruption.

cases.title: Handle abrupt interruption during bookmark save operation
cases.description: Verify the system behavior when a bookmark save operation is interrupted by an abrupt termination, ensuring item integrity or graceful recovery.

cases.title: Delete Empty Bookmarks Folder
cases.description: Verify that an empty bookmarks folder can be successfully deleted from the bookmarks hierarchy and is removed from storage and UI access points.

cases.title: Delete Non-Empty Bookmarks Folder with Contents
cases.description: Verify that deleting a bookmarks folder containing nested bookmarks and subfolders correctly removes the folder along with all its descendant items.

cases.title: Negative Test: Delete Locked or Read-Only Bookmarks Folder
cases.description: Verify that attempting to delete a bookmarks folder that is locked or marked as read-only fails gracefully with an appropriate error message and leaves the folder intact.

cases.title: Add and Delete Bookmark Separators
cases.description: Verify that bookmarks separators can be successfully added between bookmarks in the hierarchy and subsequently deleted without affecting adjacent bookmark items.

cases.title: Delete Non-Existent Separator Negative Test
cases.description: Verify the system handles attempts to delete non-existent separators gracefully without crashing or altering existing bookmark structures.

cases.title: Persistence after graceful browser restart
cases.description: Verify that all changes made to bookmarks (additions, deletions, edits, and folder creations) persist correctly after a graceful shutdown and normal browser restart.

cases.title: Persistence after sudden browser crash
cases.description: Verify that bookmark changes remain intact and do not result in database corruption or data loss when the browser experiences an abrupt, unexpected crash.

cases.title: Verify view properties negative behavior for bookmarks, folders, and separators
cases.description: Attempt to access or invoke unsupported view properties for bookmarks, folders, and separators, ensuring that the system correctly rejects the action or triggers the expected negative state.

cases.title: Inline rename bookmark normal path
cases.description: Verify that a bookmark can be renamed directly inline within the UI without opening the bookmarks properties dialog by clicking the name, modifying the text, and committing the change.

cases.title: Inline rename bookmark boundary and abort path
cases.description: Verify inline renaming behavior when handling character limit boundaries and when clicking away or losing focus without explicitly committing changes.

cases.title: Resolve bookmark via custom keyword
cases.description: Verify that a bookmark can be successfully found and opened in the browser by entering its user-defined custom keyword in the address bar.

cases.title: Keyword search with special characters and case sensitivity
cases.description: Verify the behavior of custom keywords containing special characters or distinct letter casing to ensure accurate retrieval.

cases.title: Handle non-existent or duplicate keywords (Negative)
cases.description: Verify that searching with an unregistered keyword or handling duplicate keywords appropriately falls back to standard search or displays an error/warning.

cases.title: Sort and reverse-sort bookmark columns
cases.description: Verify that bookmarks can be successfully sorted in ascending and descending order per column by clicking the column headers.

cases.title: Sort columns with special characters and empty values
cases.description: Verify column sorting handles boundary conditions such as empty fields or special characters correctly without failing.

cases.title: Resize bookmark columns to show and hide more entries
cases.description: Verify that bookmark columns can be successfully resized by dragging the column divider to show or hide more of the entry text.

cases.title: Boundary test for bookmark column width limits
cases.description: Verify the behavior of bookmark columns when resized to their minimum and maximum allowed widths, ensuring entries remain handled properly without collapsing completely.

cases.title: Show and Hide Bookmark Columns
cases.description: Verify that individual bookmark columns can be successfully shown and hidden using the column configuration interface or context menu.

cases.title: Prevent Hiding All Columns Simultaneously
cases.description: Verify the boundary behavior ensuring that hiding all columns simultaneously is prevented, maintaining a minimum required set of visible columns.

cases.title: Batch Deletion of Multiple Bookmarks
cases.description: Verify that several bookmarks can be selected and deleted at one time from the bookmarks manager, ensuring all selected items are removed from storage and UI.

cases.title: Batch Deletion Boundary and Concurrent Modification
cases.description: Verify batch deletion handling under boundary conditions such as deleting zero items versus a very large batch, and ensure robustness against concurrent modifications during deletion.

cases.title: Prevent dropping a bookmark onto itself
cases.description: Verify that attempting to drag and drop a bookmark item onto itself within the bookmarks hierarchy is blocked and does not alter the tree structure.

cases.title: Prevent dropping a bookmark onto its immediate parent
cases.description: Verify that attempting to drag and drop a bookmark item onto its immediate parent folder is rejected with a visual restriction indicator and maintains the original hierarchy.

cases.title: Prevent dropping a bookmark onto its immediate child
cases.description: Verify that attempting to drag and drop a parent bookmark item or folder onto its immediate child node is prevented to avoid circular references and structural corruption.

opinions.feedback: The proposed high-level cases are well-structured, distinct, comprehensive, and adequately cover the given requirements without any blockers.
All test cases are well-structured, properly map to their respective requirements, and include robust normal, boundary, and negative scenarios. No blockers were identified.

analysis.analysis: R-001: Testable behavior is adding a bookmark to a specified folder/location. Boundary: root vs nested folders. Normal path: valid folder selected. Abnormal path: non-existent location ID. Ambiguity: definition of specific location structure. R-002: Testable behavior is complete removal from storage and UI. Boundary: single/multiple access points. Normal path: delete via manager. Abnormal path: orphaned references in file. R-003: Testable behavior is adding/deleting personal toolbar items. Boundary: toolbar capacity limits. Normal path: drag/drop or menu action. Abnormal path: dropping invalid types. R-004: Testable behavior is inserting a folder. Boundary: depth limits. Normal path: create folder in hierarchy. Abnormal path: duplicate names. R-005: Testable behavior is launching URL on double-click. Boundary: malformed URLs. Normal path: valid HTTP/HTTPS link. Abnormal path: empty URL strings. R-006: Testable behavior is link validity in default package. Boundary: broken/expired links. Normal path: all default links return 200 OK. Abnormal path: HTTP 404/500 responses. R-007: Testable behavior is updating properties without corruption. Boundary: max length character limits for titles/URLs. Normal path: edit name and URL. Abnormal path: null values or abrupt termination during save. R-008: Testable behavior is deleting folders including contents. Boundary: empty vs non-empty folders. Normal path: delete empty folder. Abnormal path: deleting locked or read-only folders. R-009: Testable behavior is adding and deleting separators. Boundary: consecutive separators. Normal path: insert separator between bookmarks. Abnormal path: deleting non-existent separators. R-010: Testable behavior is persistence across restart or crash. Boundary: immediate crash vs graceful shutdown. Normal path: changes persist after normal relaunch. Abnormal path: database lock or corruption on sudden crash. R-011: Testable behavior is negative test of view properties for items. Boundary: unsupported property panels. Normal path: invocation triggers expected rejection/error state. Abnormal path: property dialog opens unexpectedly. R-012: Testable behavior is inline renaming. Boundary: character limits during inline edit. Normal path: click-to-rename and press enter. Abnormal path: clicking away without committing changes. R-013: Testable behavior is keyword search. Boundary: case sensitivity and special characters. Normal path: enter valid keyword to resolve URL. Abnormal path: duplicate or non-existent keywords. R-014: Testable behavior is sorting and reverse-sorting columns. Boundary: empty columns or special characters. Normal path: click column header for ascending/descending. Abnormal path: sorting on unindexed fields. R-015: Testable behavior is column resizing. Boundary: minimum and maximum column widths. Normal path: drag column divider. Abnormal path: collapsing column to zero width. R-016: Testable behavior is showing/hiding columns. Boundary: minimum required visible columns. Normal path: toggle column visibility via context menu. Abnormal path: hiding all columns simultaneously. R-017: Testable behavior is batch deletion. Boundary: zero items vs thousands of items. Normal path: multi-select and delete. Abnormal path: concurrent modification during batch delete. R-018: Testable behavior is preventing circular or self-drop. Boundary: immediate parent, self, and immediate child nodes. Normal path: drop blocked with visual indicator. Abnormal path: drop allowed into self resulting in hierarchy corruption.
